target: existing relative multi-scene Landsat-derived heat-priority rank
recommendation_reason: Spatially held-out metrics meet the pre-set feasibility threshold, but this remains a small-area surrogate sharing Landsat inputs with the target.
data_leakage_risks: NDVI and the target are derived from the same supplied Landsat scenes, so agreement may reflect shared remote-sensing signal rather than independent predictive validity.
Nearby cells have spatial autocorrelation even with block cross-validation.
Mapped green context and buildings are OSM-derived and may be incomplete or temporally mismatched.
limitations: This predicts a satellite-derived relative priority rank only, not ground-truth air temperature, heat exposure, health risk, people protected, or intervention impact.
The sample is limited to supplied local cells and cannot establish transferability beyond this pilot.
optional_display_if_kept: Show only as a collapsed 'ML heat-priority explanation (experimental)' panel beside the satellite score, with held-out MAE/R², feature contributions, and the statement that it never replaces the transparent satellite-derived score.
